entry.title: NIST Helps Fingerprint Examiners With New Data and Software Release
entry.summary: The new tools are an annotated collection of 10,000 fingerprints and a software program that can sort fingerprints according to their quality.

entry.title: NIST Researchers Develop Photonic Chip Packaging That Can Withstand Extreme Environments
entry.summary: The advance could allow these technologies to operate in deep-space probes, inside nuclear reactors, in ultrahigh vacuum systems, and at temperatures both near absolute zero and in scorchingly hot industrial settings.

entry.title: Any Color You Like: NIST Scientists Create ‘Any Wavelength’ Lasers in Tiny Circuits for Light
entry.summary: NIST scientists and collaborators have pioneered a way to make integrated circuits for light by depositing complex patterns of specialized materials onto silicon wafers.

entry.title: NIST Weighs In on the Mystery of the Gravitational Constant
entry.summary: A NIST researcher has unveiled the results of a 10-year quest to measure the constant.

entry.title: Wear and Tear Changes Measurable PFAS Levels in Firefighter Hoods, Gloves and Wildland Gear
entry.summary: In the fourth of an ongoing series of reports, NIST shows that wear and tear increased the levels of PFAS found in hoods and gloves.

entry.title: Shooting for the Moon: Ultrastable Lasers in Dark Craters Could Enable Lunar Navigation, Precision Timekeeping, New Science
entry.summary: Lunar craters in permanent shadow could be ideal locations for building the most stable optical lasers ever made.

entry.title: NIST Expands AI Consortium’s Scope, Calls for New Members
entry.summary: The consortium will focus on AI innovation and adoption, with six task groups concentrating on different aspects of AI measurement science and evaluation.

entry.title: NIST Researchers Discover a New Way to Whisk Alloys Together With Lasers
entry.summary: NIST also improved how X-rays are used to study the atomic structure of metals in real time during 3D printing, allowing researchers to observe how materials change under extreme conditions.

entry.title: New AI Model Shows How to Evacuate for Fires One Safe Step at a Time
entry.summary: A NIST-led team has created a new AI model that can identify safe evacuation routes in a single-story floor plan during a fire, with a multilevel version in the works.

entry.title: NIST Mathematical Proof Supports Transition to a Continuous-Monitor-and-Update Security Model for AI Systems
entry.summary: The proof extends to AI the logic used by famed mathematician Kurt Gödel, whose incompleteness theorems have had a profound effect on math for nearly a century.

entry.title: NIST Expands Its Library of ‘Chemical Fingerprints’ to Identify Unknown Substances
entry.summary: Researchers and manufacturers rely on the library to identify unknown compounds in food, drugs, cosmetics, the environment, body fluids, forensic evidence and even space rocks.

entry.title: NIST Releases Technical Findings on What Caused the 2021 Partial Collapse of Champlain Towers South
entry.summary: In an investigation that began just days after the tragedy, the team examined two dozen possible scenarios for where and why the collapse started.

entry.title: NIST Launches Center to Drive the Manufacture of Quantum Technologies
entry.summary: NIST has announced an agreement with SRI International to establish the Quantum Manufacturing Engineering Center (QMEC).

entry.title: Arvind Raman Confirmed as the 18th NIST Director
entry.summary: Raman comes to NIST from Purdue University, where he was the dean of engineering.

entry.title: New Fabric Test Material Could Help Strengthen Domestic Supply Chain for Textiles and Clothing
entry.summary: Researchers estimate that 56% of textiles can be recycled or recovered, but most don’t make it back into the domestic supply chain.

entry.title: NIST Receives New Patent for Microbe-Killing Water Heater
entry.summary: Warm water in household pipes can be a breeding ground for harmful bacteria.

entry.title: NIST Announces Funding Opportunity for 14 MEP Centers to Advance Small and Medium-Sized U.S. Manufacturers
entry.summary: NIST MEP will host an informational webinar on Tuesday, July 28, 2026, at 1 p.m. ET to provide general information about this opportunity and guidance on preparing applications.

entry.title: NIST Joins National Genesis Mission to Accelerate AI Innovation
entry.summary: NIST will execute two of its efforts through its Centers for AI in Manufacturing and Critical Infrastructure.

entry.title: ‘Spooky’ Particles Transit DC Suburbs, a Step Toward a Quantum Network
entry.summary: The achievement shows that fragile quantum entanglement can survive even in tough, real-world conditions.

entry.title: NIST Researchers Correct Common Error Confounding Nanotech Measurements
entry.summary: The scientists offer a practical solution that relies on accounting for measurement errors before testing materials or developing products.

entry.title: NIST National Construction Safety Team Advisory Committee Meeting Scheduled for Sept. 23 and 24, 2026
entry.summary: Anyone wishing to attend the virtual meeting must register by 5 p.m. EDT on Wednesday, Sept. 16.

entry.title: NIST Researchers Supersize Quantum Technology to Help Detect Faint Photons
entry.summary: For cutting-edge technology, from quantum computing to deep-tissue imaging, detecting every single photon counts.

entry.title: NIST-Developed Quantum Sensors Improve Nuclear Monitoring
entry.summary: New X-ray measurements will allow scientists to more accurately monitor nuclear material at power plants and weapons facilities.

entry.title: NIST Finalizes Guidelines on Protecting Online Identity and Access Tokens From Misuse
entry.summary: The finalized publication is designed to help organizations take effective steps to avoid exposing tokens to attackers.

entry.title: NIST Awards More Than $30 Million for MEP Centers in 11 States and Puerto Rico
entry.summary: The awards will help small and medium-sized manufacturers increase the adoption of advanced manufacturing technology.

entry.title: NIST Awards More Than $1.7 Million to Support Cybersecurity Workforce Development Across 8 States
entry.summary: Projects will address local cybersecurity workforce needs and will offer practical learning opportunities including internships, apprenticeships and hands-on projects.

entry.title: NIST Provides Updates on National Construction Safety Team Activities
entry.summary: The presentations highlighted the importance of NIST applying its own expertise and the expertise of others through collaborations and contracts.

entry.title: Physicist Jun Ye Wins Wolf Prize in Physics
entry.summary: The award cites Ye’s achievement in “transformative, widely applicable advances in the control of ultracold atomic systems.”

entry.title: NIST Study Shows How the Toxic Substances Mixed Into Fentanyl Vary Across the U.S. and Change Over Time
entry.summary: Alerting first responders and law enforcement to the presence of these dangerous chemicals in local supplies of fentanyl can help save lives.

entry.title: NIST Joins White House Effort to Drive ‘A New Golden Age of Science’
entry.summary: As the nation’s lead agency for measurement science and standards, NIST is uniquely positioned to bridge the distance between fundamental discovery and industrial capability.
